title: Hyundai considering U.S. production increase at new Georgia plant, CEO tells CNBC
summary_full: The potential capacity increase would be part of Hyundai's plan to invest $26 billion in the U.S. through 2028, Hyundai CEO José Muñoz told CNBC.
